notes: Optional production-tool configuration. The image_generation block is the data-driven provider registry read by publishing_house.image_gen (offline core). commercial_rights_verified drives rights clearance at ingest: a verified provider yields a `cleared` rights record; an unverified one yields `pending` and blocks the rights gate until a human reviews the provider's terms. mode `manual-only` ships by default; auto requires the gitignored tools.local.json override AND IMAGE_GEN_LIVE_ENABLED=1 AND a reachable comfyui-mcp bridge. This file itself performs no network access.

providers.name: local-sdxl
providers.notes: No revenue ceiling. QUALITY FALLBACK provider: use SDXL when flux prompt-adherence is insufficient (better at some compositions). Runs offline once weights are downloaded; treated as a local tool, not network egress.

providers.name: local-flux-schnell
providers.notes: Fully open (Apache 2.0), fastest local option. FRAMEWORK DEFAULT provider: zero-cost, zero-ambiguity. Weaker prompt adherence than dev-tier FLUX; when it is insufficient, fall back to local-sdxl. Negatives are inert at flux-schnell CFG~1 / ~4 steps — put every constraint in the positive prompt (esp. the B&W coloring line-art constraint).

providers.name: ideogram
providers.notes: Strong at in-image text/typography. Not used for covers here (covers reserve white space and Claude composites cleared fonts). Set commercial_rights_verified true only after confirming current paid-tier commercial terms.
